source.name: CShapes 2.0 / ETH Zurich International Conflict Research
source.softwarePackage: cshapes 2.0 R source package (GPL >= 2; package license is not a relicensing of the included dataset)
source.citation: Schvitz, Guy, Seraina Rüegger, Luc Girardin, Lars-Erik Cederman, Nils Weidmann, and Kristian Skrede Gleditsch. 2022. Mapping The International System, 1886–2019: The CShapes 2.0 Dataset. Journal of Conflict Resolution 66(1): 144–161. https://doi.org/10.1177/00220027211013563

method.unitOfMapping: individual modern populated-place settlement point, not the whole modern country polygon
method.spatialRule: point-in-polygon against active CShapes GW geometry on 1900-01-01; no names or modern country codes were used to infer historical sovereignty
method.statusSemantics: preserve the source's status and owner; an independent unit owns itself, dependent unit owner is the recorded GW sovereignty code
method.temporalSemantics: snapshot only; later political change must be simulated by agency and political processes, not applied as a forced year schedule
